name: btn-creative-right
title: Arrow Reveal Button
blurb: Text slides out as arrow slides in on hover.
description: A circular button where the text fades and slides to the right on hover, while an arrow and duplicate text fade in and slide from the left. A black dot in the background expands into a full-width bar.
use_when: A navigation button that should feel dynamic and invite interaction.
avoid_when: Interfaces where text should not change on hover.
a11y: Non-semantic button without label stability on hover. Keyboard support is questionable.
